entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I need to return something. It's the new VeloBand Pulse monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your full name and order number, please?
Sure, it's Maria Valenti. Order number is VF789012.
Thank you, Maria. I have your account pulled up. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's just not working right. The heart rate readings are completely wrong, and it won't stay synced. Honestly, the thing feels like a piece of **garbage** and I'm so disappointed. I've been a VeloFit customer for years and this is just... sad.

I'm very sorry to hear about the trouble you're having. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can connect you with our technical support team; they're fantastic and can usually resolve syncing issues very quickly.

Oh, I just **don't have time** for all that back and forth. I was really counting on this, and now I'm just behind on my goals. I really **just want money** back for it. Can I please just get a **refund**? I could really use that money right now.
I understand your frustration, Maria. You just want something that works right out of the box. Let me see here. I can see you received the item 15 days ago. One moment while I review the policy.

Okay, thank you for waiting. It looks like our return policy allows for returns up to 90 days from the delivery date. Since you're well within that window, I can absolutely process this return for you. No problem at all.
Oh, wow. Really? That's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Isaac. I was so worried I was going to be stuck with it.

Not at all. I'm happy to help. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file now. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
That's perfect. You've been a great help. Thank you again.
You're very welcome, Maria. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Have a good day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
